skills.name: Safe Layout Edit
skills.summary: Makes precise, reversible changes to an existing InDesign layout without disturbing unrelated content.
triggers: Move, resize, or adjust an existing layout object
Change spacing or positioning while preserving the document design
examples: Move the title down 8 millimeters, keep it inside the margin, and make sure the body text still fits.
preconditions: A document is open in InDesign.
The requested pages and targets can be identified from inspection output.
qualityCriteria: Only planned targets change.
No new text overflow or out-of-bounds content appears.
No unintended style duplication occurs.
Structural and visual results are reported separately.

skills.name: Text Typography Edit
skills.summary: Edits InDesign text and typography while preserving readability, hierarchy, and reusable styles.
triggers: Revise text in an existing text frame
Adjust typography, leading, alignment, or paragraph and character styles
examples: Set the subheads to the existing Heading 2 style and adjust leading so no line becomes overset.
preconditions: A document is open in InDesign.
The requested pages and targets can be identified from inspection output.
qualityCriteria: No overset text remains.
The typography hierarchy remains clear.
Leading and alignment are consistent across edited text.
Existing styles are reused when suitable.

skills.name: Align Distribute
skills.summary: Aligns and distributes selected InDesign page items against a stated margin, grid, or neighbor.
triggers: Align page items to a margin, grid, or neighboring object
Distribute objects with equal gaps or consistent spacing
examples: Distribute the three product cards evenly between the left and right margins with 6 millimeter gaps.
preconditions: A document is open in InDesign.
The requested pages and targets can be identified from inspection output.
qualityCriteria: Gaps are equal within the plan tolerance.
Items align to the chosen margin, grid, or neighbor.
No item leaves the page unexpectedly.

skills.name: Image Reframe
skills.summary: Reframes and crops placed InDesign images while preserving links, resolution, and planned bounds.
triggers: Crop or reframe a placed image
Resize an image frame to fit a stated composition or aspect ratio
examples: Reframe the portrait to a 4:5 crop, keep the subject's face visible, and keep the frame inside the column.
preconditions: A document is open in InDesign.
The requested pages and targets can be identified from inspection output.
qualityCriteria: The aspect ratio follows the stated crop intent.
Effective resolution is acceptable for the intended output.
Image links remain valid.
The frame stays within the planned bounds.

skills.name: Style Consistency
skills.summary: Applies existing InDesign styles and colors consistently without creating unnecessary duplicates.
triggers: Make paragraph, character, object, or color formatting consistent
Replace inconsistent local formatting with existing styles
examples: Apply the existing Body and Caption styles to the selected text and use the approved brand colors throughout.
preconditions: A document is open in InDesign.
The requested pages and targets can be identified from inspection output.
qualityCriteria: Existing styles and colors are preferred.
No duplicate styles are created without approval.
Typography remains consistent across all targets.

skills.name: Multi Page Consistency
skills.summary: Coordinates high-risk repeated InDesign changes across pages and spreads while protecting masters, folios, and unrelated content.
triggers: Apply the same change across multiple pages or spreads
Coordinate repeated elements, masters, or folios throughout a document
examples: Align the running headers on pages 2 through 12 and update the shared master without changing unrelated page content.
preconditions: A document is open in InDesign.
The requested pages and targets can be identified from inspection output.
qualityCriteria: Repeated elements align across pages.
Masters and folios remain coherent.
No unrelated page changes occur.
Approval is always required.
